record.name: Guinea
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Guinea validated a 2026-2035 national AI roadmap in December 2025; a national AI governance council is only proposed and no evaluation body is described.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. No qualifying institute was identified. English searches returned secondary coverage of the national roadmap and governance activity, without a retrieved primary national AI strategy/body source. Primary-evidence coverage remains limited. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged. A recorded query uses site. rather than the valid site: operator; it was a general search, not a reliable domain restriction.

Re-ran searches in French and English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; results described the national AI roadmap 2026-2035 validated in December 2025 after the October 2025 AI landscape assessment, and the AI Xcelerate business programme. Kept low: the 2026-2035 AI roadmap is known only from private and foreign press reports. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded fr query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in French and English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: The Lawyers Hub desk-research profile was read, but independence of its underlying citations from the paired national or press source was not verified. It is not counted as a second evidence origin. Confidence was low under that rule; none_identified is a bounded search finding, not proof of absence.

record.notes: Cited foreign sources for the governance context: Ecofin Agency; Lawyers Hub, Africa AI Policy Lab. Evidence is a press report of the ministry's announcement plus a secondary profile; no ministry text found. Searched in French and English.
